state_semantics.resolved_conflict: documented resolution only; competing evidence remains immutable and queryable

acceptance_criteria: Every trusted claim has attributable evidence and stable canonical entity references
Evidence is independently addressable, time-scoped, hashable, and auditable
Verification and contradiction state remain separate
Conflicting claims are all preserved and cannot be silently selected
Stale, rejected, unsupported, unverifiable, and future evidence remains visible
Corrections append a new revision with explicit supersedes lineage
Evidence confidence is source/verification quality only and is not prediction confidence
No Feature, Market Intelligence, Prediction, Score Engine, Shadow, Public, or Promotion output is created
blocking_conditions: contract, enum, major version, or hash boundary change is required
conflict can continue only through silent source selection or unapproved authoritative override
time or cutoff ambiguity requires guessing
Production/Supabase access or migration is required
execution scope enters V4-038 or BATCH-10
